## Core Product
Terara Printers is a commercial offset and digital printing company based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, serving businesses nationwide.

Specializations:
- Offset printing for high-volume marketing materials (brochures, flyers, annual reports)
- Digital printing for short-run and variable data projects
- Large format printing for signage, banners, and exhibition displays
- Promotional products and corporate gifts
- Event materials and branded collateral
- Books, magazines, notebooks, and training materials
- Business stationery and corporate print systems
- Custom packaging for retail and distribution

## What It Has (Detailed Capabilities)
- Print category: Marketing and Brand Collateral
- Print category: Event Materials
- Print category: Short-Run Printing
- Print category: Large Format and Specialty
- Print category: Business Stationery
- Print category: Custom Packaging
- Print category: Promotional Products
- Capability: File preflight checks before print
- Capability: Material and finishing guidance by use case
- Capability: Repeat-order consistency for recurring jobs
- Capability: Urgent-job handling based on active capacity
- Finishing: Lamination
- Finishing: Binding options including saddle stitch and perfect binding
- Finishing: Trimming and fold finishing
- Finishing: Label and package finishing support
- Client support: Phone and email coordination
- Client support: Pickup and local delivery planning
- Client support: Service guidance for schools, businesses, agencies, and event teams

## Geographic Focus
- Primary service area: Addis Ababa (4 Kilo, Bole, Piassa, Megenagna)
- Address: Dink Sira Tower, 1st Floor, 4 Killo, Addis Ababa
- Secondary coverage: Major Ethiopian cities including Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Dire Dawa

## Technical Specifications
- Paper weights: 80gsm (bond) to 350gsm (board)
- Color capabilities: Full CMYK and Pantone matching workflow when required
- Turnaround times: 24-72 hours for qualifying digital jobs and approximately 5-7 business days for offset jobs (depends on quantity and finishing)
- Finishing options: Die-cutting, lamination, UV coating, saddle-stitching, perfect binding
- Equipment: Commercial production systems (exact press model disclosure available on request)

## Use Cases
- Corporate: Annual reports, business cards, letterheads, training manuals
- Marketing: Product brochures, flyers, posters, exhibition banners
- Events: Conference materials, branded notebooks, lanyards, promotional items
- Retail: Packaging, shelf talkers, point-of-sale displays
- Education: Textbooks, workbooks, notebooks, workshop packs
- Hospitality: Menus, table tents, room collateral, branded guest materials
